name: How much does it cost to remodel a rental property in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remodel a rental property in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of remodeling a rental property in Orange County varies significantly based on the scope, materials, and property size. A minor cosmetic update, like painting and new fixtures, might range from $5,000 to $15,000. Mid-range kitchen remodels can start at $20,000 to $40,000, while a full gut renovation of a bathroom might be $10,000 to $25,000. These are general estimates; exact pricing requires a detailed assessment by a local contractor, considering specific material choices and labor rates in areas like Irvine or Huntington Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodel costs in Orange County vary widely; cosmetic updates may be $5,000-$15,000, while kitchen or bathroom renovations can range from $10,000 to $40,000 or more.
